heading: How to Do It in BC
title:
1. Check the [BCCNM consultation and referral standard](https://www.bccnm.ca/NP/PracticeStandards/Pages/ConsultationReferral.aspx) for what a request should include and what to document.
2. For advice you need today, call [RACE](https://www.raceconnect.ca/use-race); in a rural or remote community, call the matching [RTVS pathway](https://rccbc.ca/initiatives/rtvs/). For substance use, call the [BCCSU 24/7 line](https://www.bccsu.ca/24-7/).
3. For a non-urgent question, send an [eCASE](https://www.raceconnect.ca/ecase) through RACE.
4. To refer, find the specialist or clinic, and its wait time, in [Pathways BC](https://pathwaysbc.ca/).
